evidence.explanation: FANToM tested GPT-4-0314 and GPT-4-0613, finding remaining failures, worse performance with full conversations, and lower scores on binary questions requiring an additional reasoning step. Step-by-step prompting helped, and the complexity pattern was not consistent across every question format.
